items.title: Mariah Carey Checks In for Christmas in Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: WWD reports Gucci unveiled its 2026 holiday campaign film starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around Carey's Butterfly capsule collection (jackets, dresses, shoes, jewelry with a custom Gucci butterfly print) and a Gucci-ified rendition of her Christmas classic. Carey also hosted a private NYC store event with gifting and a live choir.

items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: Gucci is bringing in luxury-industry veterans Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini as senior advisers to its business units, based between Milan and Florence, working alongside creative director Demna and president/CEO Francesca Bellettini. Both previously held merchandising roles at Gucci in the 1990s-2000s before stints at Ferragamo and Versace.

items.title: Kering Group Q3 Earnings 2026: Revenues Flat as Gucci Misses
items.summary: Kering's Q3 2026 revenue was flat as reported at roughly 3.35 billion euros but down on a comparable basis; Gucci's comparable sales fell 6% (down 9% in directly operated retail/e-commerce), with lower China and Japan traffic cited as the main drag, even as Kering Jewelry (+11%) and Eyewear (+4%) grew. CEO Luca de Meo called Gucci's recovery the group's defining priority.

items.title: Gucci Sales Fell 6% as Kering Raised Its Store-Closure Target to at Least 125
items.summary: Aggregator piece (cross-checked against WWD/Kering primary disclosures) reporting Kering raised its 2026 net store-closure target to at least 125, having already completed 105 net closures by September versus an original 100-store goal; most closures are concentrated in Asia-Pacific fashion and leather goods, with Gucci accounting for the largest share of shutdowns among Kering brands.

items.title: Kering's Creative Revamp Faces Investor Scrutiny Amid Global Challenges
items.summary: Following creative director exits at Saint Laurent (Anthony Vaccarello) and Alexander McQueen (Sean McGirr), Kering CFO Armelle Poulou faced analyst questioning on an earnings call about whether further designer turnover could delay the group's recovery, with Gucci's comparable sales decline cited as part of a sector-wide China-driven slump pressuring the turnaround under CEO Luca de Meo.

items.title: Mariah Carey Defrosts in Gucci Faux Fur and Shades for New Christmas Campaign
items.summary: Complex covers the Gucci holiday spot, noting Carey models faux fur, oversized sunglasses and pieces from the Butterfly capsule (GG Marmont bags, Horsebit loafers, monogrammed boots) in a hotel setting shot by Harmony Korine, playing on Carey's established yearly Christmas-takeover internet joke.

items.title: Mariah Carey Leads Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign Amid Mixed Reactions
items.summary: Compiled Instagram/social comment reactions to the Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday film show a genuine split: some viewers called the ad 'sterile, cold, and devoid of humanity' and compared its mood to a horror series, with one blaming the house's creative direction ('it's bc of Demna'), while others praised Carey's campy, maximalist energy as fitting Gucci's audience. Treated as opinion-thermometer signal only; original comment source not independently verifiable beyond secondary aggregation.

items.title: Gucci quality concerns
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread where members trade recent ownership experiences; some report leather and canvas wear issues and hardware tarnishing on recent-season bags bought at current price points, while others defend construction quality versus peer houses at similar price tiers. Legit fandom/owner community, not brand-run.

items.title: Unpopular Gucci Opinions
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread collecting contrarian takes on Gucci design direction, pricing and resale value; recurring sentiment includes fatigue with logo-heavy pieces and skepticism that recent price increases are justified by craftsmanship, balanced against posters who still buy and defend the house.

items.title: Gucci Reviews (From First-hand Experiences)
items.summary: Aggregated consumer review page shows Gucci holding a low average rating with recurring complaints about product durability (a purse falling apart within a year, sunglasses over $650 failing after light use, shoes splitting after five wears) and customer-service responsiveness on repairs/returns. Rolling review archive rather than a single dated story; included for signal on sustained quality complaints, flagged as not fresh news.

items.title: Gucci Fall/Winter 2026/2027 Runway Analysis: Demna's Debut, Primavera Inspiration & Key Trends
items.summary: Independent fashion-review channel analyzes Demna's debut Gucci runway collection, tracing Tom Ford-era references and debating whether the direction is a genuine reinvention or derivative. Included despite older publish date because the video continues to surface in current searches alongside the Q3 recovery-narrative story the collection fed into; flagged as not within the 14-day freshness window — background context only, not counted as a fresh signal.

items.title: Gucci holiday campaign and Demna-era product drops coverage (Hypebeast front-page roundup)
items.summary: Hypebeast's running coverage folds the Mariah Carey holiday campaign into its broader tracking of Demna's 'Generation Gucci' rollout now hitting stores and e-commerce; framed within streetwear/hype audience as a test of whether Demna's aesthetic resonates with Gucci's younger US customer base. Included as a T2 NA-trade pulse-check source per registry; specific article URL could not be isolated beyond the section front in this pass.
